description: Blank text for the private wire's non-empty text checks: a string is blank when it is empty or holds only whitespace, the Unicode White_Space characters that Go's strings.TrimSpace (unicode.IsSpace) trims. whitespace lists every such character. The information separators U+001C..U+001F are text, although Python's str.isspace counts them as whitespace. Go checks unicode.IsSpace, strings.TrimSpace and contracts.ValidateOpaqueID; Python checks contracts.base.WHITESPACE, is_blank and the models' text validation.
